scope: Native TinyGo 0.43.0 compiles a six-case Go 1.26 WASI fixture. The private fallback supplies LLVM escape evidence; an independent producer preflight exercises the exact production runtime patch. This does not qualify or promote the full TinyGo browser compiler.

toolchain.nativePipeline: Stock TinyGo WASI linker uses --lto-O2; bundled wasm-opt performs --asyncify -Oz -g. No external WASI SDK linker was used for these fixtures.

cases: struct containing local pointer, string and int
array of structs containing local pointer
fixture.assertion: The same seed and value hash equally before and after 64 recursive calls, Gosched, and GC; pointee values remain valid. Scalar and string hashes also agree. Every failed invariant panics.

escapeEvidence.mechanism: The existing pointer-only Escape intrinsic receives &v. LLVM retains a heap-allocated copy of v and passes its pointer to side-effecting inline assembly with =r,0 constraints. In all four pointer-bearing cases the local pointee also has runtime.alloc(4); the fixture and those function bodies contain no pointer-to-integer conversion.
escapeEvidence.cost: The conservative fallback allocates a copy even for pointer-free or string-only values. This wasm32 IR requests 4 extra payload bytes for int and 8 for string per Comparable call, before allocator rounding and other maphash allocations. String backing storage may also escape; this is not a performance benchmark.

limitations: TinyGo asyncify uses a fixed-size task stack. Recursion, scheduling and GC are exercised, but Go moving-stack growth is not reproduced. Heap allocation is established independently from LLVM IR.
The private experiment changes one ABI helper. Production preflight separately applies the runtime subset of the producer patch; the two Wasm artifacts are recorded separately.
Six selected type shapes and native WASI execution are evidence for this fallback, not a formal proof for every generic T or a full browser compiler acceptance run.

evidence.contents: Exact fixture, baseline/fallback Wasm and captured output; complete fallback LLVM IR and allocation diagnostics; original/candidate/production helper sources and candidate patch; pinned compiler intrinsic source; independent production preflight receipt and Wasm.
